starters.title: Break down a goal

starters.materialHint: Goal, deadline, current progress and constraints (optional)

starters.prompt: Break 【goal】 into executable steps with milestones, priorities, a deadline and next actions.

starters.title: Execution plan
starters.description: Plan phases, timing, owners and checkpoints
starters.materialHint: Goal, deadline, available resources, people and constraints (optional)
starters.output: Phased plan, schedule, ownership, checkpoints and risk plan
starters.prompt: Create an execution plan for 【goal】: phases, schedule, owners, checkpoints, risks and adjustment conditions.

starters.title: Compare options
starters.description: Recommend based on cost, risk and impact
starters.materialHint: Candidate options, budget, time limits and decision criteria (optional)

starters.title: Comprehensive analysis
starters.description: Goals, current state, evidence, risks and advice
starters.materialHint: Problem, background, goals, data and constraints (optional)

starters.prompt: Analyze 【problem】 comprehensively: confirm goals and background, then cover current state, evidence, factors, risks and recommendations.
